mfaOneDevice.question: How can I set up MFA if I only have one smartphone?
mfaOneDevice.hint: Toggles instructions for setting up MFA with only one smartphone.
mfaOneDevice.answer:
The QR code used to set up your authenticator app is usually intended to be scanned with a second device. If you only have one smartphone, you can use the following alternative method:

1. Take a screenshot of the displayed QR code.
2. Open your authenticator app.
3. Use the option to import a QR code from an image or your gallery.
4. Select the screenshot and complete the setup process.

Please note that not every authenticator app supports importing QR codes from images. Google Authenticator supports importing QR codes from saved images depending on the app version.

After successfully enabling MFA, you should delete the screenshot. The QR code contains your secret TOTP key, which is used to generate your MFA codes. Anyone who gains access to this key could generate valid MFA codes for your account.
